note: Corps of Engineers campground on the north side of Beaver Bay, Lake Oahe, 16 mi W of Linton off ND 1804. Three-lane boat ramp and docks, a second ramp on the bay's SE side, fish cleaning station, playgrounds and a nature trail. --Claude
summary: rec.gov confirms 61 sites (45 30-amp, 14 non-electric RV, 2 tent), $14-22, 100% reservable with zero-day window, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14-night max, seasonal flush toilets/showers/water, dump. Fit fine (34-75 ft driveways; RV/trailer/fifth wheel). Stored lakefront looks like a view on imagery: every rec.gov 'Lakefront' site sits 60-130 m from the water across a brushy drawdown bench.
flags: WATERFRONT: suggest lakefront -> lakeview (stored value is not --AWH; apply.py does not write it). rec.gov tags 14 sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' (2-6, 9, 11, 13, 15, 31, 33, 35, 49, 50; all sold nightly). On Esri imagery none has water within 50 m over open ground: east loop site 3 (46.24832,-100.53052) is ~63 m from open water across a shrub and reed belt, sites 2/4/5/6 farther; site 15 (46.25057,-100.53699) ~60 m across a rip-rap band and a vegetated bench, sites 9/11/13 ~100-130 m; west loop site 31 (46.25161,-100.53987) sits just above a rip-rap beach with open water ~70 m beyond across a willow flat, 33/35 ~80 m through shrubs, 49/50 (46.25195,-100.54211) behind marsh and willows. DEM: site 31 ~494 m (1,621 ft) and site 3 ~492 m against water ~488-489 m, so at a normal Oahe pool (~1,600-1,610 ft) the shoreline stays 60+ m out; only near the top of the flood pool would the rip-rap line at sites 31 and 15 be lapped. Woody growth on the bench says it has been dry for years. Defaults down.
FIT / EQUIPMENT: 59 of 61 sites permit RV/Trailer/Fifth Wheel; posted lengths 34-75 ft. A 23-ft rig fits easily.
SEASON: rec.gov sells nights May 1 - Sept 30 (rate seasons); that is the reservable window and no open season is stated, so season is left unset.
